description: This file contains a C implementation of a scalar requantization function used in quantized neural network operations, particularly for low-precision matrix multiplication results. It performs rounding, scaling, addition of zero points, clamping, and efficient processing of input data in vectorized form.

methods.description: Performs vectorized requantization of 32-bit integer inputs to 8-bit unsigned integers, with scaling, zero-point addition, clamping, and processed in blocks of four.
